completed_task_requires_evidence.name: completed_task_requires_evidence
completed_task_requires_evidence.value: "task"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("task"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("task"."completion_evidence")) > 0 AND "task"."completion_evidence" IS NOT NULL)

review_decision_consistent.name: review_decision_consistent
review_decision_consistent.value: ("task_review"."outcome" = 'pending' AND "task_review"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "task_review"."decided_by" IS NULL) OR ("task_review"."outcome" <> 'pending' AND "task_review"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_review"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)

review_feedback_required.name: review_feedback_required
review_feedback_required.value: "task_review"."outcome" = 'pending' OR length(trim("task_review"."feedback")) >= 3 AND "task_review"."feedback" IS NOT NULL
